column3: Npm manifest for @deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-translator; all runtime deps are peers (session, persistence, llm, credentials, timeout, loader) so the package never owns its runtime.
Bilingual pairing record: per-heading SHA of the English and Chinese README blocks, regenerated by verify-translation-pairing --write.

Authoritative prose spec of the translator contract: resolve/translate split, anonymous vs paid routes, durable cache, full error taxonomy, plus Token-effect and KV-Cache-effect model-experience sections.
Chinese twin of the translator README; mirrors the cache-before-admission and no-provider-fallback statements verbatim.

Native Flash admission and audit-then-dispatch: owner-fiber lookup, exact-model-id catalog check, credential check, three-point eligibility revalidation, reasoning-off enforcement, non-text stream rejection.
Single TranslationError class carrying a code; the file's stated invariant is that no message ever contains submitted text or provider bodies.

Translator Cordis Service: resolve() admission (paid routes require a sessionId), translate() dispatch, endpoint URL validation, text-limit enforcement in both resolve and translate, quiescent unload.

Anonymous Google/Bing protocols, endpoint-fingerprint recipe with provider-owned query params stripped, bounded streaming JSON intake, Chinese locale normalisation, timeout vs caller-abort discrimination.

Durable translation cache: append-then-flush-then-read-back verification, in-process admission map serialising identical concurrent attempts, storage-identity re-checks after every await, malformed-record rejection.
Provider-independent types, the closed TranslationSpec union (paid variant requires sessionId), the plugin:translator/request and /result record declarations, and the ten-code error union.

Proves the durable records survive a full Host restart with credentials removed, that a cancelled consumer's pending write still commits before a retry, that a changed output-token cap invalidates the cache, and that a failed result write withholds the translated text.
Opt-in billed live smoke gated on DSH_TRANSLATION_DEEPSEEK_LIVE=1 plus a non-empty DEEPSEEK_API_KEY; asserts the exact durable events and that the main session derives no messages.
Paid-route suite asserting the exact audited wire payload (thinking disabled, one user text, no tools, no main history) and every eligibility-revalidation race.
Four-line Loader fixture with a TRANSLATION_ENDPOINT placeholder token substituted at boot by the composition test.
Fixture booting the real native provider rows against a loopback Anthropic-style SSE endpoint; supports cold restart, credential toggles, historical session seeding and activation.
Fixture for the anonymous provider with real JSONL persistence; createSession can make a live or file-only historical Session, and the loopback server recovers the exact submitted text.
Proves the storage helpers classify their own failures (TRANSLATION_STORAGE_ERROR / SESSION_REQUIRED) and preserve the exact caller abort object before the provider consumer sees them.
Queued cancellation without dispatch, ownership pinning of the live Session, withdrawn persistence provider, closed writer, and deletion of the artifact after admission.
Pins the settlement rule: after a consumer deadline, an identical retry does not settle until the held write commits and then reuses the durable result without a second provider call.

Durable-cache suite: reuse after Host restart, request-before-dispatch ordering, concurrent de-duplication, per-dimension recipe separation, endpoint change vs provider-owned param change, and six malformed-record shapes.
Anonymous-provider suite: routing, Chinese tag mapping, exact UTF-16 boundary, HTTP/redirect/malformed-payload refusals without leaking content, cancellation, disposal, and a real Loader composition.
Opt-in probes of the real anonymous endpoints, gated on DSH_TRANSLATION_LIVE=1, including a 4000-CJK-character request at the configured limit.
TS project config; rootDir src, outDir lib/types, and 13 project references naming the vendored cordis/schemastery/loader plus every peer the source imports.
Profile patch inserting the four voice rows, selecting sensevoice-local as default and resolving the provider cache directory through the dshHomePath JS helper.
36x36 plugin-manager icon: five rounded bars filled with a blue linear gradient; the only artwork in the shard, 9 lines.
English plugin-manager strings; the description states the first-use dependency install cost up front.
Chinese plugin-manager strings for the same meta.title/meta.description keys.
Bundle manifest; four runtime dependencies plus a dsh.bundle.patch key, and exports that ship the patch and locale files without loading code.
Pairing hash record for the voice-input README across 11 anchor sections.
User guide specifying the enable/setup/prepare/microphone flow and the progress vocabulary: actual download bytes, elapsed time for verification and loading, expandable step list.
Chinese twin; preserves the same UI wording and discloses that sherpa-onnx-node installs even when the bundle is disabled.
Two-line entry point (comment plus export {}); all runtime rows live in cordis.patch.yml, so the package is purely declarative.
TS config with rootDir src, outDir lib/types and a single reference to the vendored cordis.
One-line bundler config: entry lib/types/index.js to lib, ESM/node/es2024, dts false, clean false (the declarations are consumed in place).
Opt-in profile overlay: webhook runtime, the review rule, and a cordis:group isolating a second webServer on port 3081 so the ingress never exposes the UI API.
Example rule turning ready_for_review into a read-only review Session; labels the event metadata as untrusted in-band and tells the agent to refresh live PR metadata first.
Manifest; the only external runtime dependency is @octokit/webhooks, the rest are workspace peers, and the example overlay is shipped in files and exports.
Pairing hash record for the webhook-github README across 12 anchor sections.
Package reference with the config table, the seven-row HTTP status table, and the four named limitations (no TLS, generic validation only, no downstream acknowledgement, no form encoding).
Chinese twin keeping the config and HTTP status tables row-aligned with the English file.
Bounded raw-body intake: ambiguous Content-Length rejected, over-cap bodies drained rather than reset, fatal UTF-8 decoding, aborted-stream and incomplete-EOF normalisation.

HTTP handler: POST/JSON-only, exactly-one required header, per-request secret resolution, HMAC verified before JSON parsing, lossless payload snapshot, in-memory dispatch and 202 without waiting for rules.
Plugin entry: injects webServer/webhookRuntime/credentials, validates the route shape Schemastery cannot express, and registers the exact route inside an effect so unload removes it.
GitHub event type and the declaration-merging hook into WebhookEventMap; re-exports the Octokit emitter types for rule authors.

Body-intake unit suite over a synthetic IncomingMessage: malformed and unsafe Content-Length, chunked over-cap at the first byte, aborted and incomplete streams, invalid UTF-8; asserts resume is called exactly once when over cap.
Config validation suite: every invalid config throws before register is called, and disposing the fiber removes the registered route.

Real-socket HTTP suite: 202 dispatch shape, per-request secret rotation, seven invalid-input refusals with no dispatch, chunked 413 on the same connection, and no secret or payload in infrastructure diagnostics.
Real Loader integration: mounts the adapter on a real webServer through an include row and asserts 202 plus one dispatch, with no half-mounted loader entry left behind.
TS config whose references include the sibling ../webhook, making the adapter-to-runtime dependency explicit in the build graph.
Manifest; the peer set exactly mirrors WebhookRuntime.inject, and ./types is exported separately so rules can import types without the runtime.
Pairing hash record across 13 sections including the three model-experience subsections.
Maintainer contract: register/dispatch-only interface, Agent.followup as the commit point, the model-selection lifetime rule, and five named limitations including the absence of dedupe and retry.
Chinese twin preserving the commit-point sentence and the no-deduplication/no-queue limitations.
Three branded string types (rule, source, delivery) with the delivery-id docstring repeating the no-deduplication policy at the type level.

WebhookRuntime service: delivery snapshot-and-freeze, per-rule AbortController, memoised hide-abort-drain disposal, detached fire-and-forget invocation with failure containment and debug-vs-warn logging.

Transactional Session creation: pre-validated request snapshot, preset scope, workspace and agent creation, attach, permissions, title, followup commit point, and best-effort detach/dispose rollback that never masks the original failure.
Provider-neutral delivery, rule and session-request types; adds the webhook MessageSource to dsh-llm and states that deliveryId is never deduplication state.
Real Loader integration mounting the runtime and an effect-scoped rule, asserting no loader entry is left unmounted.
Runtime semantics suite including the architecture-constraint test that greps production sources for forbidden retry/dedupe/idle/completion machinery.

Session-creation transaction suite pinning the exact call order, the reasoning-effort lifetime across the first durable request header, rollback on each stage, and the commit point before a queued cancellation.
TS config with 13 references covering every runtime dependency of the service.
Manifest; peers are the six sandbox/filesystem/subprocess services, devDependencies pull the real local providers, and dsh-agent-loop-testkit appears only as a devDependency.
Pairing hash record across 10 anchor sections for the worktree README.
Package reference with a source responsibility table, an explicit refusal to keep a second projection of Git or the Session directory, and the exact Git versions that honour GIT_NO_LAZY_FETCH.
Chinese twin preserving the same Git-version enumeration and the stored-representation caveat.
Static Node child program that claims the destination directory exclusively and writes the pool .gitignore only when it created the pool.

WorktreeService: revision pinned to a commit before allocation, hooks and fsmonitor disabled per invocation, Git filters neutralised via env config overrides, exclusive destination allocation by a sandboxed child, and working-directory publication last.
Bounded confined command runner: 15 inherited Git selector variables scrubbed, prompts/LFS/lazy-fetch disabled, confinement before spawn, bounded captured output, lossy output treated as an error.
CreateWorktreeRequest and CreatedWorktree; the baseCommit docstring warns that repository-local replacement refs can change the checked-out content.

Differential Git-hardening suite: a control checkout proves the filter ran while the service checkout did not, .git/config byte-compared unchanged, branch-only includeIf filters caught, inherited replacement-base and attribute-tree selectors ignored.
Shared harness with a hermetic git() wrapper, a loud UnusedSandbox, a real Agent and a real Cordis composition; filterCommand builds an executable marker-based filter.
POSIX-only standing-policy suite: read-only refuses creation, workspace-write allows it, and a linked checkout does not widen the grant to the shared Git admin directory.

End-to-end suite: HEAD pinned against a mid-operation advance, source index and worktree byte-identical afterwards, pool gitignore, linked checkouts, concurrent same-name creation, and spawn never called when the sandbox refuses.
TS config whose references name the sandbox, sandbox-policy, subprocess, filesystem, working-directory and agent projects the service depends on.
